strategies.name: macd
strategies.description: MACD crossover strategy compiled to a WASM module. Buys when the MACD line crosses up through its signal line, sells when it crosses down; only ever opens (no close/offset).

strategies.name: macd
strategies.description: MACD strategy compiled to a WASM module. Trades either the MACD/signal-line crossover (default) or the signal line crossing zero, selectable via cross_mode; only ever opens (no close/offset).

strategies.name: macross
strategies.description: Two-moving-average crossover strategy compiled to a WASM module. Buys when the fast SMA crosses up through the slow SMA (golden cross), sells when it crosses down (death cross); only ever opens (no close/offset).

strategies.name: macross
strategies.description: Two-moving-average crossover strategy compiled to a WASM module. Buys when the fast SMA crosses up through the slow SMA (golden cross), sells when it crosses down (death cross); an invert flag swaps those sides. Only ever opens (no close/offset).
